init.title: Radoff options
init.description: Changing any of these options reloads the integration to apply it immediately.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Radoff API, in seconds. Minimum 60, default 300. A Radoff device sends one message per minute (and its radon figure covers at least five), so polling faster returns the same reading twice - it does not make the data fresher.
data_description.generate_index: Also create a qualitative *_index sensor (e.g. Excellent, Good, ...) alongside applicable measurements.
data_description.base_url: Which Radoff environment this configuration talks to. Leave it as it is unless Radoff support asked you to change it: in this API version the environment is the hostname, so a wrong value makes the integration stop loading. Clear the field to go back to the default.

missing_domain_prefix.title: Radoff does not know which domain to use for {username}

confirm.title: Finish setting up Radoff
confirm.description: The Radoff configuration for {username} does not have a domain this version of the integration can use, so it cannot load. That is expected for a configuration created before this integration supported accounts with access to more than one domain, and for one created against the previous version of the Radoff API, whose domain identifiers this version no longer accepts. Submit to sign in with the credentials already stored for this configuration and look up the domains your account can reach; if there is more than one, you will be asked which to use. Nothing is changed until then. Your devices, their history and your automations are not affected.

domain_access_denied.title: Radoff denied access to the domain used for {username}

confirm.title: Select a Radoff domain again
confirm.description: The Radoff account {username} can no longer access the domain saved in this configuration, so its devices cannot be read. The password is still valid - it is the domain that changed. Submit to look up the domains your account can reach now and select one; if there is only one, it is applied straight away. Your devices, their history and your automations are kept.
